neighbours.label: a token in a concessive construction fronting an adjective (Astute as he was, Tired as they were, Pour virtuose qu'elle soit)
fire: Clever as she was in her studies, she failed the test.
Pour talentueux qu'il soit, ce jeune auteur reste inconnu.
Hungry as they were, they shared the bread with the dog.
Rich as he became in later years, he lived simply.
Pour jolie qu'elle soit, cette maison reste trop chère.
Brave as the soldiers were, they could not hold the bridge.
Strange as it may seem, the old clock still works.
Pour intelligent qu'il soit, cet élève manque de travail.
quiet: She was clever in her studies and she failed the test.
Ce jeune auteur est talentueux et il reste inconnu.
They were hungry and they shared the bread with the dog.
He became rich in later years and he lived simply.
Cette maison est jolie et elle reste trop chère.
The soldiers were brave and they could not hold the bridge.
It seems strange, and the old clock still works.
Cet élève est intelligent et il manque de travail.

notes: Card: ' as' x2, ' the' x2, ' a' x2, 'A', ' se', ',', ' brink', ' elle'; ' as' in 'Astute as he was' and 'Pour virtuose qu'elle soit' top the card. Probes: ' as' 0.602, ' soit' 0.571, 'Tired as they were' 0.332; 'He was astute in' 0.096; 'On the brink of' 0.367 is another trigger, and is outside the label. Near misses state the same adjective plainly.
